tour_type.afternoon: 🌉 Charles Bridge Walk: * A must-see! Historic statues, views of the river and old town rooftops. → | 🕰️ Old Town Square: * Vibrant square packed with history and beautiful buildings. → | ✨ Astronomical Clock: * One of Prague’s most iconic landmarks — watch the hourly figure show. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Czech Specialties: * Try local dishes like soups, dumplings, sweet pastries or veggie options in the old town.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Vltava Riverside or Letná Park Viewpoint: * Golden-hour reflections on the water or a higher viewpoint overlooking all of Prague’s rooftops.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Chill Evening in Old Town or Riverside Promenade: * Safe, calm night walk with lights reflecting on the river, cute dessert spots and peaceful streets — perfect for relaxing.

places: 🏰 Prague Castle: | One of the oldest castle complexes in Europe with centuries of royal history.
⛪ St. Vitus Cathedral: | Gothic architecture, stained glass and historic chapels.
🧱 Old Town Square: | Medieval streets, baroque buildings and iconic landmarks.
what_to_get: 🏺 Historical Postcards: | Vintage Prague scenes, castle drawings and old-town sketches.

what_to_get: 🖨️ Art Prints: | Local artists, bridge scenes, castle viewpoints.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Špilberk Castle: * Start your day with panoramic city views, castle walls and peaceful hill paths. → | 🌿 Špilberk Park: * A gentle walk among trees with great spots for photos. → | 🏛️ Cathedral of St. Peter and Paul: * Iconic towers rising above the old town, impressive inside and out. → | ☕ Coffee in Denis Gardens Café: * Scenic gardens + calm morning break.

tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Petrov Hill or Špilberk Terraces: * Warm golden light over rooftops and towers — gorgeous sunset views.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Chill Evening Walk in Old Town or Moravian Square: * Quiet, relaxing routes with dessert cafés, student-friendly atmosphere and safe, calm streets perfect for unwinding.
